entries.title: Psalms 138:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> I will praise You with my whole heart; Before the gods I will sing praises to You.

entries.title: Psalms 138:2
segments: I will worship toward Your holy temple, And praise Your name For Your lovingkindness and Your truth; For You have magnified Your word above all Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 138:3
segments: In the day when I cried out, You answered me, [And] made me bold [with] strength in my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 138:4
segments: All the kings of the earth shall praise You, O LORD, When they hear the words of Your mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 138:5
segments: Yes, they shall sing of the ways of the LORD, For great [is] the glory of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 138:6
segments: ¶Though the LORD [is] on high, Yet He regards the lowly; But the proud He knows from afar.

entries.title: Psalms 138:7
segments: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, You will revive me; You will stretch out Your hand Against the wrath of my enemies, And Your right hand will save me.

entries.title: Psalms 138:8
segments: The LORD will perfect [that which] concerns me; Your mercy, O LORD, [endures] forever; Do not forsake the works of Your hands.
